upstreamFrontmatter.name: presentation-skill-pptx
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Builds a finished PPTX presentation in the T-Bank corporate template from a content description. Use when the user asks for a presentation, slides, a deck, a pitch, a management report, or a project review, and when they ask to edit a presentation this skill produced. You write a JSON spec and run the build script; layout, fonts, icons and palette come from the template and cannot be overridden. Requests and slide content are usually in Russian. Output is a .pptx file.
upstreamFrontmatter.compatibility: Python 3.9+ with python-pptx, lxml, Pillow, numpy, matplotlib. Runs offline; no browser or network access needed.

adaptations: Registered as an explicit user-approved exception to the local-only base profile.
Russian discovery metadata and task-scoped invocation policy; original descriptions retained in upstreamFrontmatter.
